properties.summary: Ground-floor 28 m² 1-bedroom condo at One Oasis with a private garden patio, 50" smart TV, full kitchen, free gym and shared heated pool.
description: CK Haven is a 1-bedroom condo made for every kind of traveler: a cozy bedroom with a queen-size bed, a spacious living room with a 50-inch voice-activated smart TV, a fully equipped kitchen and a bathroom with hot and cold shower.

The bedroom has spacious lockers, hangers, room-darkening curtains and a split-type aircon. The kitchen has a fridge with freezer, microwave, induction stove with hood, electric kettle, rice cooker, dining table, cooking basics and 3-stage filtered drinking water. In the living room, the sofa converts into a queen-size bed, and the 50-inch smart TV has Chromecast, Netflix and cable.

Step out the back door and down to your private garden patio for coffee under the umbrella. Wi-Fi is fast, there is an Ethernet connection and a dedicated workspace, and secure parking is available for ₱300/night. Long stays of 28 nights or more are welcome.

Inside One Oasis there’s a shared heated pool and kids’ pool (8 AM – 8 PM; ₱200 per adult and ₱100 per child, paid at the pool, or ask us to get your tickets ahead) and a residents’ gym that’s free to use. The building has an elevator, and the shower has a grab rail.
Guests have access to the whole unit. The top-level lockers are reserved for fresh linens for incoming guests; every other locker is yours.

rules.cancellation: Cancellation terms are confirmed with you in chat before you pay any deposit.
list: Extra overnight guests ₱300 each (4 guests max)
Pool: ₱200 per adult, ₱100 per child, paid at the pool
No decorations (balloons, confetti and the like)
Please eat in the kitchen and dining area, not the bedroom
No strong-smelling food (fried fish, bulad, durian)
Clean as you go: wash used dishes, trash in the bins
Keep household items in the unit (the garden is fine)
beforeCheckout: Switch off the lights, aircon, water heater and appliances
Put dishes and household items back where you found them
rules.lateCheckout: Need a late checkout? Message us as early as you can.
